steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Whenever you're ready, Chief.
In the brightly lit room, four computers are set up in a row, each seated with an operator.
The computers are equipped with software provided by Summer, capable of controlling the camera of the interlocutor's terminal to provide better tech support for this operation.
At your command, they all begin their tasks at hand.
Shawn also grabs a chair to sit next to the operators reaching out directly to the interlocutors.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Start with the ones who are more stable emotionally.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: The cruel moment has finally arrived...

Shawn's attitude toward this operation has been vague. Despite seeming resistant and evasive, she complies with the plan. Perhaps, as she's claimed, she indeed wants to understand her own dependence on these online relationships.
And you just happen to have given her the option to snap out of this numbness.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Let's begin with Atia. Objectively, she's successful in all aspects of life. We're least likely to run into a problem with her.
Summer's software works perfectly. The camera is hacked and a beautiful, fashionable Eastside woman appears on the adjacent screen.
The hacked camera enables you to see her responses so that you can cope with any potential emergencies. Of course, she can't see what's happening here.
This is of course in no way ethical, but considering the victims' mental state and safety, it's not entirely unacceptable.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Oh, my dear Sergey boo! You finally remembered to call me. Aren't you supposed to be working on some drafts these days though?
The woman says a stranger's name naturally.
Atia fiddles with her recently styled hair, glancing at the screen absentmindedly.
You've done some research beforehand. The Eastside tycoon's daughter is already 40 years old. Her impeccable appearance is proof of her wealth.
Judging by the surroundings, she seems to be in a luxurious hair salon.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Actually, there's something I want to tell you.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Are you short on cash again?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: ...No, it's not about money.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Oh, baby, you artists all have a big ego, don't you? You always sound awkward when it comes to money.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: I want you to concentrate on your art and worry about nothing else. Someone as talented as you shouldn't be troubled by this kind of thing.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: I have nothing else to give you other than money, anyway. I'll make the transfer now, alright? I don't ask for much, just think of me and chat with me whenever you're not busy making art. That will please me enough.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: ...I really don't want your money.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I have something else to tell you this time.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Something else? What could it be?
Shawn pauses for a moment, her tone low and melancholic.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: We've known each other for quite a while, right?

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Yeah, almost two years now.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: What was your first impression of me when we first met?

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Oh, but why...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Didn't you find me boring, always talking artsy nonsense?

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: But you said your perspective on the world changed after a sudden family tragedy half a year ago... You also said you'd had a crush on me for so long and only then had the courage to tell me...

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Your reluctance came from your artist pride, but you woke up from it. That prideful shell would only pull you away from your true love...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: The truth is, you've been conned.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm not the Sergey you know. After his dad went bankrupt, he didn't stay at Eastside School of Art but ran away to Outland with him.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I stole his social media account. You've been chatting with me for the past six months.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Then who... who are you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Just some catfish on the internet.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Why are you telling me all this? You could have just...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Because I've been caught.
On the other side of the camera, Atia bows her head so you can't make out her expression.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm sorry, Atia. I may have told you many lies. Even my identity is a lie. But know that...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I love you. This alone has never been a lie.
Atia lifts her head, her hand covering her mouth, her eyes slightly moist.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: I don't care that you lied... Where are you... Who caught you? I have all the money in the world. I'll bail you out. Just wait...
Seeing things take an unexpected turn, you tap Shawn on the shoulder. She shudders and only remembers what she's doing now.
She quickly switches her deeply affectionate tone to one more relaxed and teasing.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hahaha... No need for that. I'm doing pretty good now.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Besides, what I meant was basically, all of the other things I've said were lies.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: First of all, I'm not Sergey. I'm not even a man. And I don't love just you, but my over a hundred lovers...
That stuns Atia and her face visibly droops.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I've enjoyed our time together, but I've come to say goodbye. As for the money I've conned out of you, I'll return the remainder to you later.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Bye!
Before Atia can say anything, Shawn hangs up the voice call first.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's it?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Don't worry, I know her. That girl's tough inside.
Sure enough, although the voice call has ended, the camera and microphone are still under your control.
Atia stays still for a few seconds, then suddenly jumps up and starts cursing loudly.

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Keep the ******* money for your future coffin!

steps.speaker: Atia
steps.content: Scumbag! ******* liar! What a waste of time! What rotten luck for me! Go to hell!
Miss Atia won't stop cursing at her terminal.
Only when a tall, handsome young man walks into the hair salon and gently asks after her, her expression finally brightens.
At last, the farce ends with Atia walking out of the hair salon arm in arm with the man, chatting and laughing.
You notice that Shawn looks surprisingly calm as she watches her previous intimate find someone else to lean on.
It seems that cutting ties with Atia isn't enough to stir up Shawn's deepest feelings.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Alright. Next up, "Northshore Breeze"...
The operator opens up the chat skillfully, and soon the video fills the screen.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: This... is...
Shawn stutters at what she sees. Because the person on screen is not that "West District gangster" she's mentioned, but someone surprisingly young.
You even find her face somewhat familiar. You think you've seen her with the Homeless.
Seeing it's Shawn, the girl clears her throat and accepts the call.

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: What do you want?
Her voice is unexpectedly deep, almost as deep as Shawn's.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hey, just wanna...

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: We're all adults here. You don't need to sugarcoat anything.

steps.speaker: Operator
steps.content: Pfff...
Someone in the room can't hold back their laughter. Though that may expose the operation, you can't blame them, for the girl looks way too young and innocent to be saying that.
Shawn spreads her hands innocently to say she doesn't know who that is.

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: Someone's laughing next to you? Who's with you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: A colleague.

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: A male colleague?
Seeing the girl's suspicious face, Shawn scratches her head.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Fine, I lied. It's not a colleague.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And I'm not an office worker from Eastside. My identity and backstory are all made up.

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: What?!
The girl's voice jumps an octave, unable to sustain that deep tone anymore.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: See, so you haven't been truthful with me either, have you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: A little girl like you is never my type. It goes against both my preferences and morals. I've thought about it. Breaking up is our only option.

steps.speaker: Northshore Breeze
steps.content: You... you... Where do you live?! My boss is the Guardian of the Homeless! Just you wait. I'll ******* bring three truckloads of people to find you in Eastside...
Shawn hangs up abruptly before the girl can finish.

Northshore Breeze grows even more furious after Shawn hangs up on her. Fortunately, her classmate notices that and calms her down, telling her the next lesson is gym class, which helps extinguish the girl's rage.
Though she's still visibly upset, it doesn't stop her from enjoying the gym class.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Okay, that's settled. Moving on.
Shawn adjusts her headset with a neutral expression. This girl didn't show you a new side of Shawn either.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Sigh, next up is Ragdoll Kitty... I really like her. She's so shy and her voice is sweet like honey. What a cutie...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've already said that. Hurry up.
The operator doesn't let Shawn wait any longer and presses the voice call button.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: Hello...
After a brief tone, you hear a voice from the other end.
Just as Shawn's described, it's a delicate and sweet voice, like that of a cute girl from an anime. It's the first time you've heard such a voice in real life.
But maybe because the other person has the lights switched off, you can't see anything on the screen.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hey, it's me.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: Hopeless Romantic... You don't usually call me at this hour... Did something happen?
Shawn gives you a complicated look and sighs heavily, seeming agonized.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Sigh...

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: Hey... You're scaring me... What happened?
Although you can't see the other person's face, she sounds adorably pitiful, as if she's going to cry any moment.
Shawn remains silent and deliberates for a while before breaking it to her with great difficulty.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: So... I know it's sudden, but...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm breaking up with you.
The microphone picks up some loud noise. It seems she was lying on the bed until these words jolt her up.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: Did... did I do something wrong? Why would you say that...
Shawn clutches her own chest painfully.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: No, no, it's not you, it's me. I...

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: But... but...
Ragdoll Kitty's already sobbing. You hear heavy and rapid footsteps, followed by the click of a light being switched on.
The next moment, a menacing stubbled face appears in front of the camera.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: I... don't want to break up with you!
The voice remains angelic, but paired with the shaking bloated cheeks, the whole situation now seems grotesque and ridiculous.
You look at Shawn, who's completely frozen, staring at the screen with wide eyes. The entire room falls into a deathly silence.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: Why aren't you talking anymore, Hopeless Romantic?
Ragdoll Kitty speaks first after what feels like an eternity.
The way the soft voice coos seems to pull Shawn back to reality. She takes a deep breath.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm very sorry it's not you it's me I don't think we're compatible so we must break up please don't contact me anymore thank you goodbye.
Without waiting for any response, Shawn presses the end call button with all her might.

steps.speaker: Ragdoll Kitty
steps.content: What the hell...
The man tucks his double chin. His expression remains rather placid, only seeming slightly confused.
Shawn clicks on Ragdoll Kitty's profile wordlessly and hits delete and block without a moment's hesitation.
After that, she slumps powerlessly in her chair. She may be haunted by what she just saw for the rest of her life.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: ...No, I'm good.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Never thought the internet playboy would get catfished too.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Do you mind...?
Shawn sounds listless, but she still tries to sit up.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Out with the old, in with the new... No, I mean, it's better to rip off the band-aid quickly. Let's move on to the next one.
Things go smoothly from then on. Most of her online lovers seem rather stable.
Ceci, who once discussed poetry and life beyond the here and now with Shawn, the girl who's studying at Banyan Medical College while working, also appears normal.
She's in the library and seems somewhat apprehensive when she sees Shawn's call. She only accepts the call after running outside.
When Shawn tells her about the break-up, she actually looks relieved. Other than that, she doesn't appear particularly emotional.
And after hanging up, she immediately rushes back inside the library for fear that someone may take her spot. That seems to be the only thing on her mind.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Indeed, after all, love isn't a necessity in life.
Dejection is written all over Shawn's face, even more than exhaustion.
As smoothly as everything has gone, dealing with over a hundred online lovers has taken nearly ten hours. Shawn is now both physically and mentally worn out.
She seems to feel a sense of loss over splitting up with her lovers, or perhaps she's just perplexed by these uneventful "break-ups".
Fortunately, only a few names remain. But you've noticed that Shawn has deliberately skipped that girl named "Slumber under Cherry".

steps.speaker: Incoming Call
steps.content: Ting-a-ling...
Just as you want to tell Shawn to rest a bit more, you hear the sudden chimes of the ringtone.
Finally, this is happening. Before the operator reaches out to her, "Slumber under Cherry" calls Shawn first.
Shawn understands your meaning. She hesitates for a few seconds, then says.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Get it.
As she presses the accept button, the camera also activates.
On the screen is a girl who seems a little gloomy. Neither side speaks first, making the air eerily quiet.
The silence goes on for a while before the girl finally breaks it.

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: Where have you been?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Sorry... I've been busy.

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: With what?

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: What's so important that you must hide it from me? Why haven't I heard from you? You promised you'd always be there for me.
Just a few sentences into the exchange, you start to feel a twinge in your stomach.
Shawn sighs silently, which gives away her intention to her sensitive target.

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: You... you're leaving me?!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: No, I just want to set things straight...

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: You're leaving me!

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: You're leaving me? You're leaving me? You're leaving me? You're leaving me?!

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: Just like my sister did!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: No, I'm just...
On the screen, the girl shoots a chilling look.

steps.speaker: Slumber under Cherry
steps.content: So be it.
Smiling, the girl hangs up, tosses the terminal aside, and walks away.
Everything happened too fast. When the footsteps gradually fade away, it finally occurs to you that this girl's mental state is extremely fragile. She may attempt something extreme.
The operators quickly realize the severity of the situation as well and immediately begin locating "Slumber under Cherry".
You pull Shawn up from the chair and stare at her, expecting an answer.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: ...She lives in Seaside Residence 1902. Somewhere around there.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She seems to be that one special online intimate. The reason you can't untangle yourself from these virtual lies.
You've figured out a pattern in Shawn's behavior after today's operation. When interacting with these online lovers, she always keeps a subtle boundary.
It's not like her to know the other person's home address by heart.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You're right... We used to talk about everything.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Because she reminds me too much of... my past self.
In the long corridor, Shawn's voice is deep and hollow.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hating the world just because we've lost one person. We've been through the exact same thing... I hoped to compensate her, so she wouldn't fall into self-destruction like me or do anything stupid.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Come to think of it, I've probably made it worse...
Shawn's hand, which you're holding, suddenly clenches into a fist. She looks up at you, trying her best to smile naturally.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: All this talk won't change anything anyway.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Help me find her. I'll make it right...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I will save her.
